snippet.title: Plus Ultra: Legado ⚔️ | REVEAL TRAILER - A comic-style, historical Metroidvania
snippet.description:
#metroidvania #kickstarter #comic #videogames #comicvania #history #hispanic #latino #hispanoamérica #latinoamerica #historia #mexico #méxico #indie

🔥 SUPPORT US ON KICKSTARTER 🔥
🎁🧸 Exclusive Limited Rewards
🐦🐛 Early Birds
🖐🏽🔨 Physical Handcrafted Rewards! 
➡️ https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pontica/plus-ultra-legado-a-comic-style-historical-metroidvania?ref=394pr9

Plus Ultra: Legado is a 2D Metroidvania set during Mexico's inception in the 16th century. This exhilarating yet complex encounter between Europe and the Americas unfolds as a classical adventure. Using the Metroidvania genre to recount these significant historical events, Plus Ultra: Legado leads players into an exciting “comicvania” experience.

Embark on an epic adventure in which you'll see the ins and outs of one of history's most crucial events!
